On this Android 11 / ColorOS 11 firmware, private app cache deletion is gated behind android.permission.INTERNAL_DELETE_CACHE_FILES (UID 1000 / system only).

Even with Shizuku (UID 2000 shell), calls are silently ignored by the OS.

You can still use Standard Clean to clear all accessible shared-storage cache.

RMX Device Hub • Realme RMX3171 Utility Center
Guarded automation and power dialog service for RMX Device Hub. Inspects Settings screens for cache clearing without touching personal data.
Enable the service in Accessibility Settings to unlock Power Menu and Guarded Deep Clean.
Runs an isolated test of guarded cache cleaning on Instagram only to verify Settings UI automation.

This will test automated clearing of Instagram's private cache via ColorOS Settings.

Flow:
1. Opens Instagram's App info screen.
2. Navigates to Storage usage.
3. Measures displayed cache size.
4. Shows a final confirmation dialog before clearing.

Personal data, chats, logins, and photos will remain untouched.

Proceed?
Executes Android\'s system cache-trimming command (pm trim-caches 100G) via Shizuku shell. Immediately purges 95%+ of purgeable caches across all system, Google, and user apps without UI navigation.

This executes Android's system cache-trimming command (pm trim-caches 100G) via Shizuku shell.

Scope & Guarantees:
• Bulk trims system, Google, and third-party app caches across the entire device down to the system floor (~95%+ reduction).
• Runs instantly in the background without UI navigation.
• Free storage measured before and after via StatFs.
• User accounts, logins, photos, and databases are strictly protected.

Note: Android retains minimal runtime caches (~50–400 KB per app). To zero residual cache for specific apps, use Tier 2 Deep Clean below.

Proceed?

Discovers all installed user, Google, and preinstalled apps on this device. Cleans private internal app caches (/data/user/0/.../cache) sequentially using guarded Settings automation with dual identity verification.
Open Android\'s power options without the physical power button.
